2607.14642.title: MCPEvol-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agent Performance Across Dynamic Evolutions of MCP Servers
2607.14642.paper_summary: As Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers emerge as the core infrastructure for connecting LLMs with external tools, existing benchmarks leverage real-world MCP servers to evaluate LLM agents' tool-using capabilities. However, these benchmarks overlook the continuous evolution of tool interfaces and functionalities within MCP servers, resulting in flawed assessments that fail to capture the agent's adaptability in changing tool landscapes. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MCPEvol-Bench}, a novel benchmark for evaluating the task-solving capabilities of LLM agents under dynamic toolset evolution. Inspired by large-scale empirical study, we propose 11 mutation operators to simulate realistic tool evolution within 123 MCP servers. We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art LLMs on multiple versions of MCP servers, revealing that even frontier models struggle to adapt to evolving tools. For instance, GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4-6 exhibit performance declines of 13.7\% and 14.4\% in evolved MCP servers, respectively, accompanied by substantial increases in planning and reasoning errors. These findings highlight the vulnerability of LLM-driven workflows, establishing MCPEvol-Bench as a standard for evaluating agent adaptability in dynamic tool environments.
2607.14642.paper_summary_zh: 隨著模型上下文協議（MCP）伺服器成為連接大型語言模型（LLM）與外部工具的核心基礎設施，現有的基準測試利用現實世界的 MCP 伺服器來評估 LLM 代理的工具使用能力。<lb/>然而，這些基準測試忽視了 MCP 伺服器內工具介面和功能的持續演變，導致評估結果存在缺陷，未能捕捉代理在變化的工具環境中的適應能力。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們引入了 \textbf{MCPEvol-Bench}，這是一個新穎的基準，用於評估 LLM 代理在動態工具集演變下的任務解決能力。<lb/>受到大規模實證研究的啟發，我們提出了 11 種突變運算子，以模擬 123 個 MCP 伺服器內的現實工具演變。<lb/>我們在多個版本的 MCP 伺服器上對 12 種最先進的 LLM 進行基準測試，揭示即使是前沿模型也難以適應不斷演變的工具。<lb/>例如，GPT-5.4 和 Claude-Sonnet-4-6 在演變的 MCP 伺服器中，性能分別下降了 13.7\% 和 14.4\%，同時計劃和推理錯誤顯著增加。<lb/>這些發現突顯了 LLM 驅動的工作流程的脆弱性，確立了 MCPEvol-Bench 作為評估代理在動態工具環境中適應能力的標準。
